scripts.build:cloudflare: wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir ./dist/worker && bun run scripts/assert-production-bundle.ts && bun run build:cloudflare:e2e
scripts.cf:typegen: wrangler types --env-file .dev.vars.example --strict-vars=false --include-runtime=false --env-interface CloudflareEnv src/cloudflare-env.d.ts && oxfmt src/cloudflare-env.d.ts
scripts.dev:studio: NODE_ENV=development MASTRA_STORAGE_URL=https://agent-storage.enterprise-agentic-saas.localhost MASTRA_STORAGE_AUTH_TOKEN=local-agent-storage MASTRA_AUTO_DETECT_URL=true portless run --name mastra-studio.enterprise-agentic-saas mastra dev --env .env.local
scripts.storage:dev: portless run --name agent-storage.enterprise-agentic-saas bun run storage:dev:serve
scripts.studio:agents: sh -c 'set -eu; STUDIO_URL="${MASTRA_STUDIO_URL:-$(portless get mastra-studio.enterprise-agentic-saas)}"; NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="${NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS:-$HOME/.portless/ca.pem}" mastra api --url "$STUDIO_URL" agent list "{\"page\":0,\"perPage\":10}" | bun -e '"'"'const value = JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text()); console.log(JSON.stringify(value.data.map(({ id, name }) => ({ id, name }))))'"'"''
scripts.studio:smoke: sh -c 'set -eu; STUDIO_URL="${MASTRA_STUDIO_URL:-$(portless get mastra-studio.enterprise-agentic-saas)}"; RESULT=$(NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="${NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS:-$HOME/.portless/ca.pem}" mastra api --url "$STUDIO_URL" agent run product-agent "{\"messages\":\"Return exactly MASTRA_STUDIO_OK and no other text.\"}"); printf %s "$RESULT" | rg -q MASTRA_STUDIO_OK; echo MASTRA_STUDIO_OK'
